qe: What is the smallest structural and functional unit of the human body?
qh: मानव शरीर की सबसे छोटी संरचनात्मक और कार्यात्मक इकाई क्या है?
e: Concept: Cell ko 'body ki smallest structural aur functional unit' kaha jata hai, kyunki koi bhi cheez jo zinda reh sakti hai wo cell se chhoti nahi ho sakti - cell ke andar hi saara metabolism (khana banana, energy), reproduction aur growth hoti hai. Body ka har bada hissa cells se milkar bana hai: tissue = bahut se milte-julte cells ka group, organ = alag-alag tissues ka group, aur Atom ek chemical particle hai (non-living), wo zinda nahi hota. Exam point: 'Cell = structural + functional unit of life'; sabse chhoti cell PPLO/Mycoplasma hoti hai aur sabse badi koii egg.

qe: Which part of the human sperm contains mitochondria to provide motility energy?
qh: शुक्राणु के किस भाग में तैरने की गति हेतु ऊर्जा प्रदान करने के लिए माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया होते हैं?
e: Concept: Sperm me teen hisse hote hain - Head (jisme nucleus aur acrosome hota hai, DNA aur enzymes ke liye), Middle piece (jisme mitochondria ki ghanibhoot spiral hoti hai, jo swimming ke liye ATP energy deti hai) aur Tail (flagellum, jo actual movement karta hai). Isliye 'motility energy' wala sawal Middle piece ke paas jata hai. Head me mitochondria nahi hoti (wo nucleus ka dabba hai), Acrosome me digesting enzymes hote hain (egg ki wall todne ke liye, energy ke liye nahi), aur Principal end-piece tail ka aakhri hissa hai. Exam point: 'Middle piece = mitochondria = energy', 'Acrosome = enzymes', 'Tail = movement'.

qe: Which organ in the human body exhibits the highest cellular regeneration capacity?
qh: मानव शरीर के किस अंग में पुनर्योजन (Regeneration) की क्षमता सर्वाधिक होती है?
e: Concept: Liver (yakrit) body ka sabse acha regenerating organ hai - ise accidental damage ya surgical removal ke baad bachi hui liver tissue se dobara poora ug sakta hai, kyunki iske hepatocytes kuch samay tak divide karte rehte hain. Yehi wajah hai ki liver transplant me donor ka ek hissa kaafi hota hai. Baaki teen organs regeneration me kamzor hain: Brain ke neurons generally nahi regenerate hote, Heart muscle cells bahut kam divide karte hain (scar tissue ban jati hai), aur Kidney me bhi limited regeneration hoti hai. Exam point: 'Sabse zyada regeneration capacity = Liver'; 'regeneration nahi hota = neurons'.

qe: Which type of white blood cell is the largest in size and acts as a scavenger of cellular debris?
qh: कौन सा WBC आकार में सबसे बड़ा होता है और मृत कोशिकाओं व कचरे को साफ करने वाले सफाईकर्मी के रूप में कार्य करता है?
e: Concept: WBC (shwet rakt koshika) ke types me Monocyte size me sabse bada hota hai - ye ek 'scavenger' ki tarah kaam karta hai, kyunki ye tissue me nikal kar mar chuke cells ka malba (debris), bacteria aur bade particles ko kha jata hai (phagocytosis), phir macrophage ban jata hai. Lymphocyte size me chhota hota hai but immunity (antibody) banata hai, Basophil allergy/histamine se juda hai, aur Eosinophil allergy aur parasite se ladta hai (sabse kam count). Exam point: 'Largest WBC = Monocyte (scavenger)', 'WBC me sabse zyada = Neutrophil', 'sabse kam = Basophil'.

qe: Excess lipids in the human body are primarily stored in which specialized connective tissue?
qh: मानव शरीर में अतिरिक्त वसा मुख्य रूप से किस विशेष संयोजी ऊतक में जमा होती है?
e: Concept: Adipose tissue (charabi wali connective tissue) body ka mukhya fat godown hai - iske adipocytes me excess lipid (triglyceride) baundin ke roop me bhara jata hai, jo energy reserve ke saath insulation (garmi bachana) aur organ protection bhi karta hai. Dense fibrous tissue me collagen fibres hote hain (strength ke liye, fat store nahi), Nervous tissue signal bhejti hai, aur Hyaline cartilage joints ki smooth surface hai - koi bhi fat store nahi karta. Exam point: 'Fat ka godown = Adipose tissue', 'Glucose ka godown = Liver (glycogen)'.

qe: Which semi-autonomous organelle contains its own circular DNA and 70S ribosomes inside a eukaryotic cell?
qh: यूकैरियोटिक कोशिका के भीतर किस अंगक के पास अपना वृत्ताकार डीएनए और 70S राइबोसोम होता है?
e: Concept: Mitochondria ko 'powerhouse of the cell' kehte hain, par ise semi-autonomous organelle bhi kehte hain kyunki isme apna circular DNA hota hai (jise mitochondrial DNA ya mtDNA kehte hain) aur bacteria jaisi 70S ribosome hoti hai - isi wajah se ye khud kuch proteins bana sakta hai aur bacteria jaisa bartaav karta hai (endosymbiotic theory). Baaki teen organelles me apna DNA nahi hota: Golgi apparatus, Lysosome aur Peroxisome nucleus par nirbhar rehte hain. Exam point: 'Semi-autonomous = Mitochondria + Chloroplast (dono me apna DNA aur 70S ribosome)'.

qe: The enzymatic reactions of the Krebs Cycle (TCA cycle) occur within which cellular compartment?
qh: क्रैब्स चक्र (TCA चक्र) की एंजाइमी अभिक्रियाएं कोशिका के किस भाग में होती हैं?
e: Concept: Krebs cycle (TCA ya citric acid cycle) ka safar mitochondria ke andar chalta hai, aur ye cycle andar ke liquid bhar - Mitochondrial Matrix - me hota hai, jahan pyruvic acid se acetyl-CoA banakar citric acid banta hai. Ye reaction aerobic hai (O2 ke saath). Baaki teen compartments galat hain: Thylakoid lumen chloroplast me hota hai (photosynthesis ka), Intermembrane space mitochondria ke do membrane ke beech ki patli jaga hai (electron transport se juda), aur Cytosol me sirf glycolysis hoti hai (Krebs cycle se pehle ka step). Exam point: 'Glycolysis = Cytosol', 'Krebs + ETC = Mitochondria (matrix)'.

qe: Which molecule acts as the universal chemical energy currency in cellular metabolism?
qh: कोशिकीय चयापचय में 'ऊर्जा की सार्वभौमिक मुद्रा' किसे कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: ATP (Adenosine Triphosphate) ko body ka 'energy currency' kaha jata hai - iske aakhri phosphate group ke tootne (hydrolysis) se seedha usable energy milti hai, jise cell kisi bhi kaam me kharch kar sakta hai (muscle contraction, transport, synthesis). Body roj apne weight jitna ATP banati-banaati hai aur turant kharab bhi kar deti hai. Baaki teen ATP ki tarah universal currency nahi hain: Creatine phosphate (fosfagen) muscle me sirf emergency ka short-term backup hai, Glucose ek fuel hai (kaccha mal), aur Pyruvic acid ek intermediate hai. Exam point: 'Energy currency = ATP', 'Fosfagen/creatine phosphate = emergency reserve'.

qe: Muscle soreness and fatigue during strenuous anaerobic exercise are primarily caused by the buildup of:
qh: तीव्र अनॉक्सी परिश्रम के दौरान मांसपेशियों में दर्द और थकान का प्राथमिक कारण किसका जमाव है?
e: Concept: Tez anaerobic exercise (jaise tezi se daudna, gym ke reps) me muscle ko oxygen kam milta hai, to glucose adhure dhange se tootkar pyruvic acid banata hai, jo aage Lactic Acid me badal jata hai. Yahi lactic acid muscle me jama hokar dard, jalan aur fatigue (thakan) paida karta hai. Baaki teen aise nahi bante: Acetic acid vinegar me hota hai (sirf patli aant me banta hai), Uric acid protein-purin ke tootne se banta hai (gout me jama hota hai, exercise se nahi), Pyruvic acid lactic acid se pehle ka step hai. Exam point: 'Anaerobic exercise me fatigue = Lactic acid', 'Gout = Uric acid'.

qe: Which mitotic stage is most suitable for karyotyping and analyzing chromosome morphology?
qh: गुणसूत्रों की संरचना और आकारिकी के अध्ययन के लिए समसूत्री विभाजन की कौन सी अवस्था सर्वोत्तम है?
e: Concept: Karyotyping (chromosome ka photo-chart) ke liye Metaphase best stage hai, kyunki is stage me chromosomes sabse zyada condensed (moti aur chhoti) ho jate hain aur ek hi plate (equatorial plate) me saaf safar line me khade ho jate hain - isliye unka shape, size aur centromere aasaani se dekh aur count ki ja sakti hai. Prophase me wo dhage jaise thin hote hain, Anaphase me tootkar bikhrane lagte hain, aur Telophase me uncoiled hokar invisible ho jate hain. Exam point: 'Karyotyping/chromosome morphology study = Metaphase (sabse condensed stage)'.

qe: Household table sugar derived from sugarcane is chemically known as:
qh: गन्ने से प्राप्त साधारण घरेलू चीनी का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
e: Concept: Ganne se bana ghar ka cheeni (table sugar) ek disaccharide hai jiska naam Sucrose hai - ye glucose + fructose se banta hai. Ye ped me photosynthesis ka product banata hai aur phir khane ke liye refine hota hai. Baaki teen usi ki tarah mithi hain par simple sugars hain: Glucose 'blood sugar' hai (diabetes me isi ki maatra dekhi jati hai), Fructose fruit sugar hai (glucose ka ek partner hissa), aur Lactose doodh ki sugar hai. Exam point: 'Table sugar/cheeni = Sucrose', 'Blood sugar = Glucose', 'Milk sugar = Lactose'.

qe: Which organelle contains the genomic material and serves as the command center of eukaryotic cells?
qh: कोशिका की सभी गतिविधियों को नियंत्रित करने वाला 'नियंत्रण केंद्र' या 'मस्तिष्क' कौन सा अंगक है?
e: Concept: Nucleus cell ka 'control room' hai kyunki isme cell ki saari genomic material (DNA genes) rehti hai, jo protein banane ke orders deti hai; isme Nucleolus (rRNA factory) aur nuclear pores hote hain jinse materials aa-jaate hain. Isi wajah se nucleus ke bina cell zyada der zinda nahi reh sakta (RBC apna nucleus kho deta hai, isliye wo sirf ~120 din chalta hai). Baaki teen organelles DNA nahi rakhte (mitochondria me thoda hai par command center nahi): Ribosome proteins banata hai, Mitochondria energy, Golgi apparatus packing. Exam point: 'Command center = Nucleus', 'Protein factory = Ribosome', 'Powerhouse = Mitochondria'.

qe: Which common suffix denotes carbohydrate sugars in biochemical nomenclature?
qh: जैव रासायनिक नामकरण में कार्बोहाइड्रेट शर्कराओं को किस प्रत्यय (Suffix) द्वारा पहचाना जाता है?
e: Concept: Biochemistry me ek pattern yaad rakho: jyadatar sugars ke naam -ose se khatam hote hain (glucose, fructose, sucrose, lactose, maltose) - yahi suffix carbohydrate ka pehchaan hai. Baaki teen suffix doosri cheezon ke liye use hote hain: -ine proteins/alkaloids aur amino acids ke liye (protein, glycine, caffeine), -ate salts aur esters ke liye (nitrate, phosphate, lactate), aur -ase enzymes ke liye (amylase, lipase). Exam point: '-ose = sugar', '-ase = enzyme', '-ine = protein/alkaloid' - ye amino-acid style jodi yaad rakho.

qe: The primary natural disaccharide found in mammalian milk is:
qh: दूध में पाई जाने वाली प्राकृतिक डाइसैकेराइड शर्करा कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Doodh (mammalian milk) ki mukhya shakkar Lactose hai - ye glucose + galactose se bana disaccharide hai, isliye ise 'milk sugar' kehte hain; lactose ki paachan kshamta umar ke saath kam ho jati hai (lactose intolerance). Baaki teen alag sugars hain: Maltose ankurit anaj se (jau ka sugar), Galactose ek monosaccharide hai jo lactose ka hissa hota hai (khud milk sugar nahi), aur Sucrose ganna-chini ki sugar hai. Exam point: 'Milk sugar = Lactose (glucose + galactose)'.

qe: Which bone cells synthesize and deposit new organic bone matrix during ossification?
qh: हड्डियों के निर्माण और मरम्मत के लिए नई मैट्रिक्स बनाने वाली कोशिकाएं कौन सी हैं?
e: Concept: Bone ki haddi banane ki process (ossification) me Osteoblasts 'raj-mistri' hote hain - ye naya organic bone matrix (ossein/collagen) banate aur usme calcium salts jama karte hain, isliye bone grow karta hai aur fracture bhar jata hai. Baaki teen alag cells hain: Chondrocytes cartilage banate hain, Osteocytes haddi me phanse mature cells hain (maintenance karte hain, naya matrix nahi banate), aur Osteoclasts haddi ko todte hain (resorption). Exam point: 'Bone builder = Osteoblast', 'Bone breaker = Osteoclast', 'Mature trapped = Osteocyte'.

qe: Which multinucleated cells are responsible for bone resorption and degradation of mineralized bone matrix?
qh: पुरानी या क्षतिग्रस्त हड्डियों के ऊतकों को घोलकर नष्ट करने वाली कोशिकाएं कौन सी हैं?
e: Concept: Haddi ki constant renovation ke liye do cells team ki tarah kaam karte hain: Osteoblasts ko banate hain aur Osteoclasts purani/pathological haddi ko resorb (kha jaate) hain, jisse minerals ka balance rehta hai aur haddi ka aakar chust rehta hai. Osteoclasts bahut bade, multinucleated cells hote hain (multiple nuclei fuse hokar bante hain) aur acid + enzymes chhodhkar mineralized matrix todte hain. Baaki teen galat hain: Osteoblasts banate hain (tod nahi), Fibroblasts connective tissue ke fibres, aur Osteocytes matured hain. Exam point: 'Osteoclast = multinucleated bone-resorbing cell (osteoporosis me isi ka role hota hai)'.

qe: Mature, non-dividing bone cells trapped within mineralized lacunae are called:
qh: अस्थि मज्जा के मैट्रिक्स में फंसी परिपक्व गैर-विभाजनकारी हड्डी कोशिकाएं क्या कहलाती हैं?
e: Concept: Jab bone matrix ban jata hai to kuch osteoblasts usme band (entrap) ho jate hain - aise matured, non-dividing cells ko Osteocytes kehte hain; ye chhote-chhote lacunae (gaddha) me baithe rehte hain aur long cell processes (canaliculi) ke zariye apas me contact rakhte hain. Inka kaam haddi ki day-to-day maintenance aur mineral (calcium) exchange hai. Baaki teen mature bone cells nahi hain: Chondroblasts cartilage banate hain, Osteoclasts haddi todte hain, aur Osteoblasts naya matrix banate hain. Exam point: 'Mature bone cell (lacuna me) = Osteocyte'.

qe: Which viscous fluid lubricates diarthrodial (movable) joints to minimize frictional wear?
qh: चल जोड़ों में घर्षण को रोकने और चिकनाई देने वाला द्रव कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Aisi jodi jahan do haddiyan milkar hilti hain (knee, elbow, shoulder) unhe diarthrodial ya synovial joints kehte hain - inke beech ek cavity hoti hai jisme Synovial fluid bhara hota hai. Ye fluid ek thick, chikna lubricant hai jo cartilage ko ghisne se bachata hai aur joints ko frictionless hilne deta hai; ye joint capsule ke synovial membrane se banta hai. Baaki teen fluids doosri jagah hote hain: Pericardial fluid heart ke aas-pas, Cerebrospinal fluid brain-spine me, aur Peritoneal fluid pet ki gufa me. Exam point: 'Movable joint ka lubrication = Synovial fluid (arthritis me ye kam ya inflamed ho jata hai)'.

qe: The organic collagen-based structural protein matrix of bones is called:
qh: मानव हड्डियों के जैविक मैट्रिक्स में पाया जाने वाला प्रमुख प्रोटीन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Bone ke do hisse hote hain: ek organic part (jo lachak aur tensile strength deta hai) aur ek inorganic part (calcium phosphate, jo sakhti deta hai). Organic part mukhya rup se collagen protein ka banta hai, jise bone me special naam Ossein se jante hain - isi ki wajah se haddi seedhi bhi rehti hai aur mudi bhi nahi. Baaki teen alag proteins hain: Elastin elastic fibres me (skin/lung), Myosin muscle me, aur Keratin baal-nakhon me. Exam point: 'Bone ka organic matrix = Ossein (collagen)', 'Inorganic = calcium phosphate (65%)'.

qe: Cardiac muscle tissue is characterized by being:
qh: हृदयक पेशी (Cardiac muscle) की संरचनात्मक और कार्यात्मक प्रकृति कैसी होती है?
e: Concept: Heart ka muscle (cardiac muscle) teen khaas baaton se pehchana jata hai: (1) Involuntary - hum ise apni marzi se nahi chala sakte, (2) Striated - isme bhi halki pattiyan hoti hain, aur (3) Myogenic - iska contraction khud heart ke pacemaker se shuru hota hai, brain se signal ka intezaar nahi karta. Baaki teen combos galat hain: 'involuntary and non-striated' smooth muscle hai (aanto me), aur 'voluntary' wale combos skeletal muscle ke liye hain (jise hum marzi se hilate hain aur jo multinucleated hota hai). Exam point: 'Cardiac = involuntary + striated + myogenic'.

qe: Which iron-bearing hemoprotein imparts a red hue to skeletal muscle and stores oxygen locally?
qh: मांसपेशियों को लाल रंग देने वाला और ऑक्सीजन का संचय करने वाला वर्णक कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Muscle ko apna oxygen reserve chahiye hota hai, aur ye kaam Myoglobin ek protein karta hai - ye haemoglobin jaisa iron wala protein hai jo muscle me oxygen ko bandh (store) kar leta hai aur zaroorat par deta hai; isi ki wajah se fresh muscle gehra laal dikhta hai. Ye haemoglobin bhai-behen hai: haemoglobin blood me poore sharir ko oxygen deta hai, par myoglobin local store hai. Baaki teen galat hain: Cytochrome electron transport chain me, Hemocyanin copper wala protein hai (keede/molluscs me), aur Hemoglobin blood me hota hai (muscle me nahi). Exam point: 'Muscle ka oxygen store = Myoglobin (myo = muscle)'.

qe: What is the approximate total count of skeletal muscles in the human body?
qh: मानव शरीर में कंकाल मांसपेशियों की कुल अनुमानित संख्या कितनी है?
e: Concept: Human body me skeletal muscles ki sankhya lagbhag 639 hoti hai (textbooks me 600 se 650 ke beech batate hain, kyunki counting ke tareeke alag-alag hote hain) - ye wo muscles hain jo haddiyon se jude hote hain aur sharir ko hilate hain. Baaki teen numbers doosri cheezein batate hain: 206 adult haddiyon ki sankhya hai, 512 kuch nahi, aur 750 bhi kuch nahi. Exam point: 'Muscles ~639', 'Haddiyan = 206' - ye do sankhyaein kabhi mix na karo.

qe: Which is anatomically recognized as the largest (most voluminous) muscle in the human body?
qh: मानव शरीर की सबसे बड़ी (आयतन में) मांसपेशी कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Body ka sabse bada (most voluminous) muscle Gluteus Maximus hai - ye hips/buttocks me hota hai, aur ise volume/weight ke hisaab se sabse bada muscle kaha jata hai. Iska kaam ulta: daudne, koodne aur khade hone me hip ko seedha rakhna. Baaki teen chhote ya patle hain: Pectoralis major chest me (Biceps jaisa dikhta hai par chhota), Sartorius body ka sabse lamba muscle hai (bada nahi), aur Latissimus dorsi peeth ka chauda muscle hai (Gluteus se chhota). Exam point: 'Sabse bada/voluminous = Gluteus Maximus', 'sabse lamba = Sartorius'.

qe: The longest skeletal muscle running obliquely down the anterior thigh is the:
qh: कूल्हे से घुटने तक जाने वाली मानव शरीर की सबसे लंबी मांसपेशी कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Sartorius ko body ka sabse lamba skeletal muscle kaha jata hai - ye jaangh ke aage ki taraf tirchha (oblique) chal kar pelvis se ghutne ke neeche tak jata hai; ise 'tailor's muscle' bhi kehte hain, kyunki darzi (tailor) ke baithne ke aasan me yahi muscle kaam karta hai. Baaki teen thigh muscles chhote hain: Gracilis andar ki taraf, Rectus femoris quadriceps ka hissa, aur Biceps femoris hamstring ka hissa. Exam point: 'Sabse lamba muscle = Sartorius'.

qe: Which minute skeletal muscle in the middle ear is the smallest in the human body?
qh: मानव शरीर की सबसे छोटी मांसपेशी कौन सी है, जो मध्य कान में स्थित होती है?
e: Concept: Human body ka sabse chhota skeletal muscle Stapedius hai - ye kaan (middle ear) ke andar hota hai aur stapes (sabse chhoti haddi) se juda hota hai; iska kaam bahut tez aawaz par apne aap sikud kar stapes ko rokna hai, taaki kaan ke andar ka hissa tootne se bache (acoustic reflex). Baaki teen chhote muscles hain par Stapedius se bade: Corrugator (bhonch), Anconeus (kohni), aur Tensor tympani (eardrum ko tight karna). Exam point: 'Sabse chhoti muscle = Stapedius (kaanu me)', 'sabse chhoti haddi = Stapes'.

qe: Based on physiological force exerted per unit area, which is considered the strongest muscle?
qh: दबाव और बल के संदर्भ में मानव शरीर की सबसे मजबूत मांसपेशी कौन सी मानी जाती है?
e: Concept: 'Sabse strong muscle' ka sawal thoda technical hai - agar force ko area ke hisaab se dekhein (per unit area), to jaw ka Masseter muscle sabse zyada force lagata hai, kyunki ye daant ko bhichkar sakat cheezein (badam, sugarcane) todta hai - iske bite force me ~25kg se zyada lage ka pressure hota hai. Baaki teen yahan aate nahi: Biceps brachii badi muscle hai par per-unit-area me kamzor, Uterus sabse strong muscular organ kaha jata hai (baby delivery me) par woh skeletal muscle nahi hai aur sawal physiological force/unit area poochh raha hai, Soleus bahut der tak kaam karta hai (endurance me best). Exam point: 'Per unit area sabse strong = Masseter (jaw)'.

qe: What is the specialized cytoplasm of a muscle fiber called?
qh: मांसपेशी कोशिका (फाइबर) के कोशिका द्रव्य को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Muscle fibre ke andar ke cytoplasm ko Sarcolemma nahi, balki Sarcoplasm kehte hain - ye ek vishesh cytoplasm hai jisme myofibrils, mitochondria, glycogen granules aur myoglobin bhare rehte hain, aur yahin muscle ki energy ka aadhaar hota hai. Isi jaisi vocabulary yaad rakho: Sarcolemma = muscle cell ki membrane (bahari khol), Axoplasm = nerve fibre ka cytoplasm, aur Cytosol = saadharan cell ka liquid hissa. Exam point: 'Muscle ka cytoplasm = Sarcoplasm', 'Muscle ki membrane = Sarcolemma', 'Nerve ka cytoplasm = Axoplasm'.

qe: Which motor proteins directly interact to generate sliding-filament muscular contractions?
qh: मांसपेशियों के संकुचन के लिए कौन से दो मुख्य संकुचनशील प्रोटीन जिम्मेदार हैं?
e: Concept: Muscle contraction ka sliding-filament theory kehta hai ki do protein fibres ek doosre ke upar sarakti hain - Actin (patli filament) aur Myosin (moti filament, jo ATP + calcium ki maujoodgi me actin ko kheech leta hai), isse sarcomere chhota hota hai aur muscle sikud jati hai. Ye process myosin head ke 'power stroke' se hota hai. Baaki teen protein jodiyan contraction me nahi hain: Collagen-elastin connective tissue ki strength aur lachak ke liye, Tubulin-dynein cilia/flagella aur spindle ki movement ke liye, aur keratin-fibrin baal aur blood clot se. Exam point: 'Muscle contraction = Actin + Myosin + ATP + Ca2+'.

qe: Which tissue category encompasses blood, bone, cartilage, and loose aerolar tissues?
qh: रक्त, हड्डी, कार्टिलेज और वसा किस ऊतक श्रेणी के अंतर्गत आते हैं?
e: Concept: Human body me 4 mukhya tissue hote hain: Epithelial (dhakka/cover), Muscular (movement), Nervous (signal) aur Connective tissue. Connective tissue hi wo category hai jisme bahut alag-alag dikhne wale tissue aate hain - blood (dravya), bone (sakht), cartilage (lachakdar) aur loose areolar (jo organs ko bharta hai) - inme sab me cells ke beech ka 'matrix' zyada hota hai, yahi iski pehchaan hai. Baaki teen categories specific kaam karti hain: Epithelial covering, Nervous signalling, aur Muscular contraction. Exam point: 'Connective tissue = blood, bone, cartilage, tendon, ligament, adipose - sab ek hi family'.

qe: What is the scientific term for the microscopic study of biological tissues?
qh: ऊतकों के सूक्ष्म संरचनात्मक अध्ययन को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Tissue ke microscopic study ko Histology kehte hain (histos = tissue). Kyunki tissue dhaan (cells) se milkar banta hai, aur bimari ka pata lagane ke liye aajkal tissue ka biopsy karke histology ki jaati hai. Baaki teen alag fields hain: Osteology haddiyon ki study (osteo = bone), Myology muscles ki study (myo = muscle), aur Cytology cell ki study (cyto = cell). Exam point: 'Tissue = Histology', 'Cell = Cytology', 'Haddi = Osteology', 'Muscle = Myology' - ye jodi aksar aati hai.

qe: Proteins are unbranched polymers built from monomeric building blocks called:
qh: प्रोटीन किसके बहुलक (पॉलिमर) होते हैं?
e: Concept: Protein ek polymer hai jiske monomoer 'Amino acids' hote hain - amino acids peptide bonds se judkar lambi chain (polypeptide) banate hain; 20 tarah ke amino acids se duniya ke sabhi proteins bante hain. Isliye protein ko 'body ka building block' kehte hain (muscle, enzyme, hormone, antibody sab protein hi hain). Baaki teen alag polymers ke monomer hain: Nucleotides DNA/RNA ke, Monosaccharides carbohydrate ke, aur Fatty acids lipid (fat) ke. Exam point: 'Protein ka monomer = Amino acid', 'Carbohydrate = Monosaccharide', 'DNA = Nucleotide'.

qe: Which primitive form of direct cell division occurs in bacteria without spindle formation?
qh: जीवाणुओं में बिना तुर्क तंतुओं के होने वाला प्रत्यक्ष सरल कोशिका विभाजन क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Amitosis ek sabse saral, 'primitive' cell division hai jisme nucleus aur cytoplasm seedha do hisson me baant diye jate hain - koi spindle fibre nahi banta, isliye ise 'direct cell division' bhi kehte hain. Bacteria aur unicellular organisms isi pattern (binary fission) se badhte hain. Baaki teen me spindle/structured machinery lagti hai: Karyokinesis nucleus ka division hai (mitosis/meiosis ka hissa), Meiosis gametes banane ke liye, aur Mitosis body cells ke liye. Exam point: 'Bacteria = Amitosis/Binary fission (spindle nahi banta)'.

qe: Which scientist first coined the term 'Protoplasm' in 1839 for the living cellular substance?
qh: 1839 में कोशिका के जीवित द्रव के लिए 'जीवद्रव्य' (Protoplasm) शब्द का प्रयोग किसने किया था?
e: Concept: 'Protoplasm' shabd 1839 me Czech scientist Jan Evangelista Purkinje ne diya tha - ye cell ke andar ka wo zinda, semi-liquid padarth hai jisme nucleus + cytoplasm dono aate hain; ise 'cell ka physical base of life' bhi kehte hain (Huxley ne ise 'physical basis of life' kaha). Baaki teen alag discoveries ke naam judute hain: Robert Brown ne nucleus khoja (1831), Felix Dujardin ne 'sarcode' shabd diya (protoplasm ka purana naam), aur Rudolf Virchow ne kaha 'Omnis cellula e cellula'. Exam point: 'Protoplasm (1839) = Purkinje'.

qe: Which non-neuronal glial cells divide and account for the vast majority of primary intracranial brain tumors?
qh: मस्तिष्क की कौन सी सहायक कोशिकाएं अनियंत्रित विभाजन कर ब्रेन ट्यूमर का कारण बनती हैं?
e: Concept: Brain ke cells do prakar ke hote hain - Neurons (signal bhejne wale) aur Glial cells (support/maintenance wale). Glial cells hi divide (mitosis) kar sakte hain, isliye brain ke primary tumors (glioma) glial cells se hi bante hain aur neuron-wale tumors bahut kam hote hain. Baaki teen galat hain: Neurons mature hone ke baad divide nahi karte (isliye brain damage fix karna mushkil hai), Microglia immune cells hain (tumor yahan se kam bante hain), Schwann cells peripheral nerve ke bahari layer ke cells hain. Exam point: 'Brain tumor = glial cells se (glioma)'.

qe: Somatic cell division yielding two genetically identical diploid daughter cells is termed:
qh: शरीर की कायिक कोशिकाओं में होने वाला समरूप विभाजन जिसके द्वारा दो समान कोशिकाएं बनती हैं, कहलाता है:
e: Concept: Somatic (body) cells me division ka do tarah ka pattern hota hai - Mitosis me ek cell se do cells bante hain jinme chromosome number same (diploid, 2n) rehta hai aur DNA bilkul copy jaisa hota hai, isliye ye growth, repair aur dead cells badalne ke liye hota hai. Baaki teen shabd galat ya alag hain: Meiosis gametes ke liye (number aadha), Amitosis bacteria ka, aur Sporogenesis spores banane ke liye. Exam point: 'Growth/repair = Mitosis (2n se 2n)', 'Gametes = Meiosis (2n se n)'.

qe: Meiotic cell division produces which functional cellular outcome?
qh: अर्धसूत्री विभाजन (Meiosis) के अंत में क्या परिणाम प्राप्त होता है?
e: Concept: Meiosis ek 'reduction division' hai - isme do ek ke baad ek divisions (Meiosis I aur II) hoti hain, jisse ek cell se 4 cells bante hain aur chromosome number aadha (haploid, n) ho jata hai. Sabse khaas baat: crossing over se genetic material exchange hota hai, isliye chaaron gametes genetically alag (non-identical) hote hain - yahi variation ki jad hai. Baaki teen galat hain: '2 identical diploid' mitotic output hai, aur '4 identical diploid' kahin nahi hota. Exam point: 'Meiosis = 4 haploid, non-identical gametes (variation paida karta hai)'.

qe: The longest phase of the eukaryotic cell cycle, encompassing growth and DNA synthesis, is:
qh: कोशिका चक्र की सबसे लंबी अवस्था जहाँ कोशिका वृद्धि करती है और डीएनए का संश्लेषण होता है:
e: Concept: Cell cycle me sabse lamba phase Interphase hi hota hai (~90-95% samay) - isme cell normal kaam karta hai, badhta hai aur DNA ki copy banata hai; ye G1 (growth), S (DNA synthesis) aur G2 (double check) me banta hai. Baaki teen chhote phases hain: Prophase, M phase (mitosis) aur Cytokinesis - ye sab milkar bhi interphase se bahut kam samay lete hain (ek ghante ke andar). Exam point: 'Cell cycle ka sabse lamba phase = Interphase (usme bhi S-phase me DNA double hota hai)'.

qe: Which cytoskeletal structures attach to kinetochores to pull sister chromatids to opposite poles?
qh: कोशिका विभाजन के दौरान गुणसूत्रों के काइनेटोकोर से जुड़कर उन्हें ध्रुवों की ओर खींचने वाले तंतु कौन से हैं?
e: Concept: Sister chromatids ko torne aur alag-alag poles tak pahunchane wali rasiyan Spindle fibres (microtubules) hoti hain - ye tubulin protein se banti hain aur kinetochore se judkar chromosomes ko kheenchti hain, jaise koi rassi-gadi. Baaki teen cytoskeletal ya connective elements ye kaam nahi karte: Collagen fibrils tissue me strength dete hain, Intermediate filaments cell ko shape, aur Actin microfilaments movement ke doosre kamo me (jaise cytokinesis ring, muscle). Exam point: 'Chromosome khichne wali = Spindle fibers (microtubules, tubulin protein)'.

qe: Who first observed dead cork cells under a compound microscope in 1665?
qh: 1665 में कॉर्क के टुकड़े में मृत कोशिकाओं की खोज सबसे पहले किसने की थी?
e: Concept: Robert Hooke ne 1665 me khud ke banaye microscope se cork (bottle ka dhaatu) ki patli slice dekhi - us me chhote-chhote khane dikhe, jinhe usne 'cells' naam diya. Wo waqai me dead (khaali) cell walls thi, isliye ye 'cell' ki pehli khoj maani jati hai aur Hooke ko 'Father of Cytology' kehte hain. Baaki teen aage ki discoveries hain: Theodor Schwann cell theory (1839 me), Antonie van Leeuwenhoek ne 1674 me pehli baar zinda microbes dekhe, aur Robert Brown ne nucleus khoja (1831). Exam point: 'Cell ki khoj (1665, dead cork) = Robert Hooke'.

qe: Who first discovered and recorded motile living microorganisms (bacteria/protozoa) in 1674?
qh: 1674 में जीवित कोशिका (जैसे बैक्टीरिया और प्रोटोजोआ) को सबसे पहले किसने देखा था?
e: Concept: Antonie van Leeuwenhoek (ek Dutch dukaan daar, jisne apne hi lense banaye) ne 1674 me sabse pehle zinda, chalte-firte microorganisms (bacteria, protozoa, sperm) ko apne darpan me dekha aur describe kiya - isliye unhe 'Father of Microbiology' kehte hain. Robert Hooke ne dead cork ke khane dekhe the (1665), par zinda microbes unhe nahi dikhe the. Louis Pasteur aage chalke fermentation aur germ theory se jude, aur Marcello Malpighi anatomy/microanatomy ke. Exam point: 'First living cell/microbes dekhe = Leeuwenhoek (1674)'.

qe: Which organelle acts as the endomembrane structural framework, preventing the cell from collapsing?
qh: कोशिका को आंतरिक सहारा और कंकाल प्रदान कर पचकने से रोकने वाला अंगक कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) cell ke andar protein aur lipid ka transport network (naaliyon jaisa) banata hai - iska jaal poore cytoplasm me phaila hota hai aur isi ki wajah se cell andar se sahaari (framework) ban jata hai, jo cell ko collapse nahi hone deta. Iska rough wala hissa (RER) protein banata hai aur smooth (SER) lipid banata hai. Baaki teen galat hain: Peroxisome chhota detox organelle hai, Golgi apparatus packing karta hai, aur Centrosome division me spindle banata hai - koi cell ka structural framework nahi hai. Exam point: 'ER = cell ka endomembrane + internal support'.

qe: Why are lysosomes designated as the 'Suicide Bags' of eukaryotic cells?
qh: लाइसोसोम को कोशिका की 'आत्मघाती थैली' क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: They leak toxic ions into blood
They contain acid hydrolases that digest the parent cell upon rupturing
e: Concept: Lysosome ek membrane-bound thaili hai jisme 'acid hydrolase' naam ke tej digestive enzymes (40 se zyada) bharte hain; ye cell ke andar aa gaye kachre/bacteria ko paach jati hai. 'Suicide Bag' kehne ka kaaran ye hai ki agar bahut nuksaan ho ya membrane phat jaye to ye apne hi enzymes chhod kar poore cell ko paach daalti hai (autolysis) - isliye yahi cell ka suicide weapon hai. Baaki teen kaam lysosome nahi karte: toxic ions blood me chordhna, ATP synthesis rokna, aur protein transcription block karna - ye sab kisi aur organelle ka kaam hai. Exam point: 'Lysosome = suicide bag + cell ka digestive system'.

qe: Which ribonucleoprotein complexes translate mRNA templates into polypeptide chains (Protein Factories)?
qh: कोशिका में प्रोटीन निर्माण के लिए जिम्मेदार 'प्रोटीन फैक्ट्री' कौन सा अंगक है?
e: Concept: Ribosome ek chhota, membrane-less organelle hai jisme rRNA + protein hote hain - ye mRNA ki tape padhkar amino acids jodta jata hai aur polypeptide (protein) banata hai, isliye ise 'Protein Factory' kehte hain. Iska bada-hissa rough ER par chipka hota hai aur kuch cytoplasm me free hota hai. Baaki teen ye kaam nahi karte: Lysosome digestion karta hai, Centrosome spindle banata hai (division), aur Vacuole storage karta hai. Exam point: 'Protein factory = Ribosome' (mitochondria aur chloroplast me bhi 70S ribosome hote hain).

qe: Which organelle sorts, glycosylates, and packages macromolecules for secretion or dispatch?
qh: प्रोटीन और लिपिड को पैक करके परिवहन करने वाला कोशिका का 'डाकघर' (Packaging Unit) कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Golgi apparatus ER se aaye proteins aur lipids ko receive karta hai, unme sugar (glycosylation) jodta hai, unki packing karta hai aur phir kis jagah bhejna hai (secretion ya cell ke andar) ye chhanta hai - isliye ise 'cell ka post office' kehte hain; lysosome ke enzymes bhi Golgi se hi banti hain. Baaki teen ye kaam nahi karte: Centrosome division me spindle, Lysosome digestion, aur Mitochondria energy banati hai. Exam point: 'Sorting/packaging/posting = Golgi apparatus (post office of the cell)'.

qe: Which plant cell wall constituent is digested during fruit ripening, causing softening?
qh: पादप कोशिका की मध्य पटलिका (Middle Lamella) मुख्य रूप से किसकी बनी होती है?
e: Concept: Fal pakne (ripening) ke saath unme pectinase jaise enzymes active hote hain jo 'Calcium aur magnesium pectate' (middle lamella ka pectic material) ko tod dete hain - jo cells ke beech glu thi, wo kamzor pad jati hai, isliye aam kela naram ho jata hai. Baaki teen ripening me nahi kate: Cellulose fibrils (cell wall ka pakka hissa) zyada ter tak rehte hain, Chitin fungi/keede me hota hai (plant me nahi), aur Lignin to sakhti badhata hai (rips ke badle). Exam point: 'Fruit softening = pectin (middle lamella) ka banna/tutna'.

qe: The 'Fluid Mosaic Model' proposed by Singer and Nicolson in 1972 describes the cell membrane as:
qh: 1972 में सिंगर और निकोलसन द्वारा दिए गए 'फ्लूइड मोजेक मॉडल' के अनुसार कोशिका झिल्ली क्या है?
o: A rigid protein matrix enclosing lipids
A fluid phospholipid bilayer with mobile embedded proteins
e: Concept: 1972 me Singer aur Nicolson ne 'Fluid Mosaic Model' diya - iske hisaab se cell membrane ka basic dhaancha 'fluid phospholipid bilayer' hai (do paraton me tail-andar, head-bahar), aur usme proteins kirch ke tukde (mosaic) ki tarah tairte rehte hain - ye proteins aur lipids dono side me sarak sakte hain, isliye membrane 'fluid' hai. Baaki teen galat ideas hain: rigid protein matrix aur solid carbohydrate sandwich purane models hain (Danielli-Davson), aur sirf cholesterol ki parat membrane nahi banti (cholesterol sirf ek component hai jo fluidity manage karta hai). Exam point: 'Fluid Mosaic Model = Singer & Nicolson (1972)'.

qe: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum (SER) is highly developed in hepatocytes for which biochemical role?
qh: यकृत कोशिकाओं में चिकनी अंतःप्रद्रव्यी जालिका (Smooth ER) का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
e: Concept: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum (SER) - jisme ribosome nahi chipke hote - liver (hepatocyte) cells me bahut developed hota hai, kyunki yahin lipid, cholesterol aur steroid hormones banana aur dawa/alcohol jaise bahari chemical (xenobiotic) ka detoxification hota hai. Isliye jyada daru peene wale me SER badh jata hai (tolerance badhta hai). Baaki teen kaam SER nahi karta: rRNA synthesis nucleolus me hoti hai, aerobic respiration mitochondria me, aur protein synthesis rough ER/ribosome par. Exam point: 'SER = lipid synthesis + detoxification (liver me sabse zyada)'.

qe: The acrosomal cap on the anterior head of a spermatozoon originates from the transformation of the:
qh: शुक्राणु के शीर्ष पर अंडाणु को भेदने वाला 'एक्रोसोम' किस अंगक से विकसित होता है?
e: Concept: Sperm banne ki process (spermiogenesis) me spermatid ke Golgi apparatus se ek thaili nikal kar sar ke aage chipak jaati hai, jo 'Acrosomal cap' kehlati hai - isme hyaluronidase jaise enzymes hote hain jo egg ke aavran (zona pellucida) ko todkar andar jaane me madad karte hain (yaad rakho: acrosome Golgi ka gift hai). Baaki teen ye kaam nahi karte: Centriole se tail ka flagellum banta hai, Mitochondria middle piece me ghoomkar energy deti hai, aur Peroxisome cell ke metabolism me hota hai. Exam point: 'Acrosome (enzymes wali topi) = Golgi apparatus se banta hai'.

qe: Which membrane surrounds the large hypertonic central vacuole of a mature plant cell?
qh: पादप कोशिका की केंद्रीय रसधानी को घेरने वाली एकल अर्ध-पारगम्य झिल्ली क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Mature plant cell ki badi central vacuole ke charon taraf ek ek-cell membrane hoti hai, jise Tonoplast kehte hain - ye semi-permeable hai aur paani/ions ka aana-jaana control karti hai, jisse vacuolar sap aur cytoplasm alag rehte hain aur cell ka turgor bana rehta hai. Baaki teen alag jodi hain: Pericarp falon ki deewar (fruit wall), Plasmalemma cell ki bahari membrane (cell wall se andar chipki), aur Crista mitochondria ki andar ki folding. Exam point: 'Central vacuole ki membrane = Tonoplast'.

qe: Genetic recombination (Crossing Over) occurs during which specific substage of Meiotic Prophase I?
qh: अर्धसूत्री विभाजन I के प्रोफेज I की किस उप-अवस्था में 'क्रॉसिंग ओवर' (जीन विनिमय) होता है?
e: Concept: Meiosis ke Prophase I ke 5 substages hote hain - Leptotene (chromosome dhaage jaise dikhte hain), Zygotene (homologous chromosome jode bante hain/synapsis), Pachytene (jodo me crossing over hokar genes ka exchange hota hai - genetic recombination yahin hota hai), Diplotene (jode alag hone lagte hain, chiasmata dikhte hain) aur Diakinesis (antim packing). Baaki teen isse pehle/baad ki stages hain: Zygotene me pairing, Leptotene me thread formation, aur Diplotene me separation - inme crossing over nahi hoti. Exam point: 'Crossing over = Pachytene (recombination ka asli stage)'.

qe: In which substage of Prophase I do paired homologous chromosomes begin separating, revealing Chiasmata?
qh: प्रोफेज I के किस चरण में सिनेप्टोनीमल कॉम्प्लेक्स घुल जाता है और 'X-आकार' के काइऐज्मेटा दिखाई देते हैं?
e: Concept: Prophase I ke Diplotene stage me homologous chromosomes (jinke beech crossing over ho chuki hai) ek doosre se alag hone lagte hain, par jahan crossing over hui thi wahan wo chipke rehte hain - is cross-connection ko Chiasma (bahu-vachan Chiasmata) kehte hain; ye crossing over ka visible proof hota hai. Baaki teen stages isse alag hain: Pachytene me crossing over hoti hai (chiasmata dikhna wahin se shuru), Zygotene me pairing, aur Diakinesis me terminalization (chiasmata sarre chale jate hain). Exam point: 'Chiasmata dikhna = Diplotene; crossing over = Pachytene'.

qe: Centriole duplication in the cytoplasm occurs synchronously with nuclear DNA replication during the:
qh: कोशिका चक्र के किस चरण में केंद्रक में डीएनए और कोशिका द्रव्य में सेंट्रीओल का द्विगुणन होता है?
e: Concept: Cell cycle me DNA replication S phase (Synthesis) me hota hai, aur centriole ki copy bhi isi S phase me saath-saath (synchronously) hoti hai - taaki jab M phase me cell divide ho, uske paas do centriole jod ke spire bana rahe ho. Baaki teen phases me copy nahi hoti: G1 me cell normal badhta hai, G2 me protein banta hai (duplicate nahi), aur M phase me actual division hota hai (usme pehle se bani copies ka istamaal hota hai). Exam point: 'DNA + centriole dono ki copy = S phase'.

qe: Who expanded the Cell Theory with the aphorism 'Omnis cellula e cellula' (all cells arise from pre-existing cells)?
qh: 'सभी कोशिकाएं पूर्व-मौजूद कोशिकाओं से उत्पन्न होती हैं' (Omnis cellula e cellula) का सिद्धांत किसने जोड़ा?
e: Concept: Cell Theory (Schleiden + Schwann, 1839) ne kaha - sab jeev cells se bane hain aur cell life ki unit hai, par ye nahi bataya ki cell kahan se aata hai. 1855 me Rudolf Virchow ne apna mashhoor vaakya 'Omnis cellula e cellula' diya - 'har cell kisi pehle se maujood cell se hi banta hai' - isse Cell Theory poora hua. Baaki teen aage-peeche ke scientists hain: Matthias Schleiden (plants), Theodor Schwann (animals), aur Louis Pasteur (germ theory/fermentation). Exam point: 'Omnis cellula e cellula = Rudolf Virchow (1855)'.

qe: Which protein complex holds duplicated sister chromatids together from S-phase until anaphase onset?
qh: एनाफेज तक दोनों सिस्टर क्रोमैटिड्स को एक साथ बांधकर रखने वाला प्रोटीन कॉम्प्लेक्स कौन सा है?
e: Concept: S phase me DNA ki copy ban jati hai, par do copies (sister chromatids) alag nahi hoti - unhe kinetochore ke paas chipkaye rakhta hai ek ring jaisa protein complex jise Cohesin kehte hain; ye Anaphase shuru hote hi tod diya jata hai, tab chromatids alag ho paate hain. Baaki teen alag kaam karte hain: Tubulin spindle ka protein hai, Kinesin ek motor protein hai (cheezein dhaata hai), aur Condensin chromosome ko compact (pack) karta hai. Exam point: 'Sister chromatids chipkaye rakhne wala = Cohesin'.

qe: Colchicine is an antimitotic alkaloid that arrests dividing cells in metaphase by inhibiting:
qh: कोल्चीसिन दवा कोशिका विभाजन को मेटाफेज में किस प्रक्रिया को बाधित करके रोक देती है?
e: Concept: Colchicine (Colchicum autumnale se milne wala alkaloid) spindle ke microtubules ko banna (polymerization) rokta hai - spindle hi nahi banega to chromosomes metaphase plate par khade nahi ho sakte aur ek-ek karke alag nahi ho sakte, isliye cell metaphase me hi ruk jata hai. Isi guna se iska upyog plant breeding (polyploidy banane me) aur gout ke ilaaj me hota hai. Baaki teen enzymes nahi hain: Peptidyl transferase ribosome me, DNA polymerase copy banata hai, aur ATP synthase energy banata hai. Exam point: 'Colchicine = microtubule/spindle inhibitor = metaphase arrest'.

qe: What is the specialized region on the centromere where kinetochore microtubules attach?
qh: गुणसूत्र के सेंट्रोमियर पर स्थित वह प्रोटीन डिस्क क्या कहलाती है जिससे स्पिंडल फाइबर जुड़ते हैं?
e: Concept: Centromere chromosome ka wo hissa hai jahan se dono chromatids jude rehte hain, aur uske upar ek protein-disc banti hai jise Kinetochore kehte hain - yahi 'hooks' hain jinse spindle fibres (microtubules) bandhte hain aur chromosome ko kheench kar poles tak le jate hain. Baaki teen alag hain: Centrosome spindle banane wala organelle (animal cells me), Chromocenter kuch chromosomes ke hetrochromatin ka dhaan (joda), aur Telomere chromosome ka aakhri sira (protective cap). Exam point: 'Spindle ki attachment site = Kinetochore (centromere par)'.

qe: Cytokinesis in terrestrial plant cells occurs via centrifugal vesicle fusion called the:
qh: पादप कोशिकाओं में कोशिका द्रव्य का विभाजन (Cytokinesis) किस विधि द्वारा केंद्र से बाहर की ओर होता है?
e: Concept: Animal cells me cytokinesis 'cleavage furrow' se hota hai (bahar se andar ki taraf kheench), par plant cells ke bahar sakht cell wall hoti hai, isliye bahar se kheench nahi hoti - waha cell ke beech me Golgi se aane wali vesicles jama hokar andar se bahar ki taraf ek 'Cell Plate' banati hain, jo aage chalkar do cells ke beech nayi middle lamella aur cell wall bana deti hai (centrifugal method). Baaki teen animal/bacteria ke methods hain: Cleavage furrow, Budding (yeast), aur Invagination. Exam point: 'Plant cell division = Cell Plate (centrifugal), Animal = Cleavage furrow (centripetal)'.

qe: The quiescent, non-proliferative state where cells exit the active cell cycle is designated:
qh: कोशिका चक्र की वह शांत अवस्था जहाँ कोशिकाएं चक्र से बाहर निकलकर विभाजन बंद कर देती हैं:
e: Concept: Cell cycle se bahar nikal kar jahan cell divide karna band kar deta hai, koi growth nahi karta (ya bahut kam karta hai) aur sirf apna kaam karta rehta hai - us state ko G0 (quiescent stage) kehte hain; jaise mature neurons, muscle cells aur heart cells. Ye cells zaroorat par kuch conditions me wapas cycle me aa sakte hain (jaise liver cells). Baaki teen active phases hain: G1 (growth), S (DNA copy) aur G2 (division ki tayari) - teeno me cell cycle chal raha hota hai. Exam point: 'Jahan cell divide nahi karta = G0 phase'.

qe: The number of sequential mitotic division cycles required to produce 128 cells from one progenitor is:
qh: एक कोशिका से समसूत्री विभाजन द्वारा 128 कोशिकाएं बनाने के लिए कितने चक्रों की आवश्यकता होगी?
e: Concept: Har mitotic division me ek cell se do cells bante hain (2^n), isliye n divisions me 2^n cells bante hain. Yahan 128 chahiye: 2^7 = 128, isliye 7 divisions lagengi. Baaki teen answer galat hain: 64 to 2^6 ke baad milta hai (6 divisions), 127 = 128-1 (bekaar), aur 14 dedh gunna hai. Exam point: 'Ek cell se 2^n cells; 128 cells ke liye 7 divisions' - square/number wale sawal aksar aate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se 7 sahi hai. Aise prashn mein anya vikalp doosre maapdandon ya doosri rashiyon se aa jaate hain, isliye sahi rashi ko dohra kar likhna chahiye.

qe: A chromosome possessing a centromere positioned at the absolute terminal end is classified as:
qh: जिस गुणसूत्र का सेंट्रोमियर बिल्कुल अंतिम छोर पर स्थित होता है, वह क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Centromere ki position chromosomes ko 4 prakar me baantti hai: Metacentric (beech me, dono bhaag barabar), Sub-metacentric (thoda side), Acrocentric (sire ke paas) aur Telocentric (bilkul antim sire/chhor par, yahan ek bhaag lagbhag gayab ho jata hai). Isliye 'absolute terminal end' wala centromere Telocentric kehlata hai. Baaki teen beech ya thoda side ke hain: Sub-metacentric, Acrocentric aur Metacentric. Exam point: 'Centromere position se naam: Meta (beech), Sub-meta, Acro, Telo (sira)'.

qe: Which phase of mitosis acts essentially as the structural reverse of Prophase?
qh: समसूत्री विभाजन की कौन सी अवस्था प्रोफेज की संरचनात्मक विपरीत (Reverse) मानी जाती है?
e: Concept: Telophase me prophase ka sab kuch ulta hota hai - chromosomes phir se lambe-dhaage (uncoil) ho jate hain, nucleolus aur nuclear membrane dobara ban jate hain, spindle toota jaata hai aur do nucleus ban jate hain. Isi 'reverse' kaam ki wajah se ise 'structural reverse of Prophase' kehte hain. Baaki teen galat hain: Interkinesis meiosis ke do divisions ke beech ka break hai, Metaphase me chromosomes plate par hote hain, aur Anaphase me chromatids alag hokar bhaagte hain. Exam point: 'Prophase ka ulta = Telophase'.

qe: Which dense nuclear subcompartment is the site of ribosomal RNA (rRNA) transcription and assembly?
qh: केंद्रक के अंदर राइबोसोमल आरएनए (rRNA) के निर्माण और असेंबली का स्थल कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Nucleolus nucleus ke andar ek dense, gol, membrane-less dhaan hai jahan ribosomal RNA (rRNA) banta hai aur usme protein daalkar ribosome ke hisse assemble (assembly) hote hain - isliye badhti/zyada protein banane wali cells (jaise neuron, cancer cell) me nucleolus bada dikhta hai. Baaki teen nucleus ke doosre hisse hain: Nuclear lamina nucleus ko andar se sahara deta hai, Karyotheca nuclear envelope (membrane) hai, aur Nucleoplasm nucleus ka liquid hissa hai. Exam point: 'rRNA + ribosome assembly ka dhaan = Nucleolus'.

qe: Programmed, non-inflammatory cellular suicide during development and tissue maintenance is termed:
qh: अनावश्यक या क्षतिग्रस्त कोशिकाओं की प्राकृतिक क्रमादेशित मृत्यु (Programmed Cell Death) कहलाती है:
e: Concept: Apoptosis ek 'programmed', control ki hui cell ki maut hai - cell khud ke genes ke signal par chhote-chhote tukdon me batata hai aur immune cells unhe bina suchan (inflammation) saaf kar dete hain; ye fingers ki shape, tadpole ki tail girna aur roj-purane cells hatane ke liye hota hai. Necrosis usse alag hai - wo accidental/chot se marta hai aur aas-paas ka tissue soojh kar inflammation paida karta hai. Baaki teen shabd galat hain: Autolysis = khud ke enzymes se paach jaana (lysosome), Lysis = cell ka phatna, Necrosis = accidental cell death. Exam point: 'Programmed cell death = Apoptosis (cancer me apoptosis ruk jata hai)'.

qe: Which molecular adapter carries cognate amino acids to the ribosomal A-site during translation?
qh: प्रोटीन संश्लेषण के दौरान राइबोसोम तक विशिष्ट अमीनो एसिड लाने वाला एडेप्टर अणु कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Translation (protein banane) me mRNA tape hai, aur aaRNA nahi - ise tRNA (Transfer RNA) kehte hain. tRNA ke ek sire par amino acid aur doosre sire par anticodon hota hai jo mRNA ke codon se mel khata hai; isse ribosome ke A-site par sahi amino acid pahunchta hai aur chain lambi hoti jati hai. Baaki teen doosre kaam karte hain: rRNA ribosome ka hissa banta hai, snRNA splicing me, aur mRNA message carrier hai (blueprint). Exam point: 'Amino acid dhaane wala = tRNA (adapter molecule)'.

qe: Which of the following serves as a classic 'Stop Codon' terminating ribosomal translation?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'स्टॉप कोडॉन' (समापन कोडॉन) है जो प्रोटीन संश्लेषण को रोकता है?
e: Concept: Protein banane wale genetic code me kuch codons 'Stop' ke signal hote hain - jaise UAA (jise 'ochre' kehte hain), UAG aur UGA. Jab ribosome in par pahunchta hai to chain ka kaam ruk jata hai aur protein chhod diya jata hai. Baaki teen codons aise nahi hain: CAU histidine ka code hai, AUG 'start' codon hai (methionine), aur UGG tryptophan ka code hai. Exam point: 'Stop codons = UAA, UAG, UGA' (UAA sabse aam). Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar UAA baithta hai. Pariksha mein yahi baat ghoomakar poochhi jaati hai, isliye maapdand tatha formula dono saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which enzyme catalyzes the transcription of single-stranded RNA into complementary DNA (cDNA)?
qh: आरएनए (RNA) से पूरक डीएनए (cDNA) बनाने वाला एंजाइम कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Reverse Transcriptase ek khaas enzyme hai jo RNA ke template se DNA bana deta hai (reverse ya ulta direction), yahi wajah hai ki ise 'RNA-dependent DNA polymerase' bhi kehte hain. Ye enzyme retrovirus (jaise HIV) me hota hai, jo apne RNA ko DNA me badalkar host ke genome me daal deta hai - biotechnology me isi se cDNA (complementary DNA) banate hain. Baaki teen ye kaam nahi karte: DNA Ligase jodta hai, Topoisomerase dhaage suljhata hai, aur RNA Polymerase II DNA se RNA banata hai (normal direction). Exam point: 'RNA se DNA = Reverse Transcriptase (HIV)'.

qe: The nucleosome structural subunit of chromatin consists of DNA wrapped around an octamer of:
qh: क्रोमैटिन की संरचनात्मक इकाई 'न्यूक्लियोसोम' में डीएनए किसके अष्टक (Octamer) के चारों ओर लिपटा होता है?
e: Concept: Chromosome ke andar DNA ko chhoti golakaat (bead) ki tarah pack kiya jata hai - har bead ek Nucleosome hoti hai, jisme DNA ki 147 base pair lambi rassi 8 Histone proteins ke gol (octamer) par do baar lipat kar baithi hoti hai. Isi packing se lambi DNA chhoti jagah me aa jati hai aur genes silent bhi ho jate hain. Baaki teen proteins nucleosome nahi banate: Ribosomal proteins ribosome me, Actin microfilaments me, aur Tubulin microtubules (spindle/cilia) me. Exam point: 'Nucleosome = DNA + 8 histone octamer'.

qe: Which intercellular junction allows direct electrochemical communication via connexon channels in animal tissues?
qh: जंतु कोशिकाओं के बीच आयनों और छोटे अणुओं के सीधे आवागमन की अनुमति देने वाला संधि स्थल कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Gap junctions do padosi animal cells ke beech ek chhota 'dwaar' (channel) banate hain, jinme connexin protein ke 'connexon' pipe lagte hain - inse ions aur chhote molecules seedha ek cell se doosre cell me ja sakte hain (jaise heart muscle me contraction ka signal ek saath pahunchana). Baaki teen alag kaam karte hain: Desmosomes cells ko chipkaye rakhte hain (spot-weld), Hemidesmosomes epithelia ko basement membrane se jodte hain, aur Tight junctions do cells ke beech chust seal lagate hain (paani leak nahi hone dete). Exam point: 'Direct communication (connexon) = Gap junctions'.

qe: The modified smooth endoplasmic reticulum that sequesters and releases Calcium ions in muscle fibers is the:
qh: मांसपेशी कोशिकाओं में संकुचन हेतु कैल्शियम आयनों का संचय और विमोचन करने वाला अंगक कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Muscle fibre ke andar ek vishesh smooth ER hoti hai jise Sarcoplasmic Reticulum kehte hain - ye Calcium (Ca2+) ions ko store karti hai aur nerve signal aane par unhe chhod deti hai; Ca2+ hi actin-myosin ko judne ka signal deta hai, isliye contraction hota hai. Aur paani nikalne ke baad ye Ca2+ ko wapas soakh leti hai, tab muscle dhili hoti hai. Baaki teen ye kaam nahi karte: Golgi matrix packing, Rough ER protein, aur T-tubule (jo surface membrane ka andar-badha hua hissa hai) electrical signal andar le jata hai. Exam point: 'Muscle me Ca2+ ka store = Sarcoplasmic Reticulum'.

qe: The failure of homologous chromosomes or sister chromatids to disjoin during cell division is called:
qh: कोशिका विभाजन के दौरान गुणसूत्रों का ठीक से अलग न हो पाना (Non-disjunction) क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Normal cell division me homologous chromosome (meiosis) ya sister chromatids (mitosis) theek se alag ho jate hain - par kabhi kabhi ye ek saath ek hi pole par chale jate hain aur unki gintee bigad jati hai, isse ek cell me kam aur doosre me zyada chromosome aa jate hain. Is galti ko Non-disjunction kehte hain, aur isse Down syndrome (Trisomy 21), Klinefelter aur Turner syndrome jaise disorders hote hain. Baaki teen alag karye hain: Duplication (hissa dobara), Translocation (hissa doosre chromosome par), aur Crossing over (normal, recombination). Exam point: 'Chromosome separation fail = Non-disjunction (aneuploidy ka kaaran)'.

qe: Which molecular chaperone assists nascent unfolded polypeptide chains in achieving correct three-dimensional conformation?
qh: कोशिका के भीतर नए बने प्रोटीनों को सही त्रि-आयामी (3D) आकार में मोड़ने में कौन मदद करता है?
e: Concept: Protein banne ke baad usko sahi 3-D aakar me lipatna padta hai, warna wo kaam nahi karega - is kaam me 'Chaperone proteins' (Hsp70, Hsp60) madad karte hain, jaise master ji student ko sahi mudhne me help karte hain. Ye unfolding/galat folding rok kar protein ko sahi conformation dete hain; stress (garmi) me ye badh jate hain (heat shock proteins). Baaki teen galat hain: Ribozyme kuch RNA enzymes hain, Proteasome purane protein todta hai (TATA machine), aur Ubiquitin proteasome ko signal deta hai ki ye protein todna hai. Exam point: 'Protein ki sahi folding = Chaperone proteins'.

qe: The semi-conservative nature of DNA replication was experimentally validated by:
qh: डीएनए की अर्ध-संरक्षी (Semi-conservative) प्रतिकृति की पुष्टि किस वैज्ञानिक प्रयोग द्वारा हुई थी?
e: Concept: DNA replication semi-conservative hai (jisme purani chain + nayi chain milkar naya DNA bana hai) - iska proof 1958 me Meselson aur Stahl ne diya, jinhone E. coli ko heavy nitrogen (15N) me badha kar density gradient me dekha; DNA ki patti exactly beech me dikhi (hybrid). Baaki teen alag discoveries hain: Watson-Crick ne 1953 me double helix model diya (structure, proof nahi), Griffith ne 1928 me transformation dikhaya, aur Hershey-Chase ne 1952 me prove kiya ki DNA hi genetic material hai. Exam point: 'Semi-conservative replication ka experimental proof = Meselson & Stahl'.

qe: Which fungal and insect exoskeleton component is an unbranched polymer of N-acetylglucosamine?
qh: कवक की कोशिका भित्ति और कीटों के बाह्य कंकाल में पाया जाने वाला पदार्थ कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Chitin ek nitrogen-yukt polysaccharide hai jo N-acetylglucosamine (NAG) ke sugar units ka unbranched polymer hai - ye fungi ki cell wall me aur keedo ke bahari kavach (exoskeleton) me hota hai, aur bahut mazboot hai (isliye keede ka kavach sakht hota hai). Baaki teen alag polymers hain: Peptidoglycan/murein bacteria ki cell wall me, Dextran bacteria aur dhaatu me glucose ka polymer, aur Cellulose plant cell wall ka polymer. Exam point: 'Fungi/keede ka kavach = Chitin', 'Bacteria = Peptidoglycan', 'Plant = Cellulose'.

qe: Which photosynthetic structures consist of disc-shaped thylakoids stacked within chloroplast stroma?
qh: क्लोरोप्लास्ट के स्ट्रोमा के भीतर थाइलाकोइड्स के सिक्कों जैसी ढेर संरचना क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Chloroplast ke andar Thylakoid (patli, disc jaisi thaili) hoti hain, aur jin jagah ye thailiyan coin ke stack jaisi parat me jami hoti hain unhe Grana (ek vachan Granum) kehte hain. Grana hi wo jagah hai jahan chlorophyll hote hue light reaction (photolysis + ATP/NADPH) hota hai. Baaki teen alag structure hain: Cristae mitochondria ki andar ki folding (respiration), Cisternae ER/Golgi ki thailiyan, aur Lenticels periderm ke pores (gas exchange). Exam point: 'Thylakoids ka stack = Grana (light reaction ka site)'.

qe: The net passive movement of solvent water molecules across a selectively permeable membrane along a water potential gradient is:
qh: अर्ध-पारगम्य झिल्ली के माध्यम से जल के अणुओं की उच्च जल विभव से निम्न विभव की ओर गति क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Osmosis ek khusus prakar ka diffusion hai - isme paani (solvent) ke molecules ek selectively-permeable membrane (jo sirf paani ko jaane deti hai) ke through kam concentration wale hisse se zyada concentration wale hisse ki taraf chalta hai; yeh simple diffusion se alag hai kyunki isme membrane lagti hai aur ye water potential gradient follow karta hai. Isi se plant me turgor banta hai aur root paani leta hai. Baaki teen galat hain: Simple diffusion bina membrane, Pinocytosis cell ka paani peena (bada particle), aur Active transport me ATP lagti hai (Osmosis passive hai). Exam point: 'Paani ka membrane ke through movement = Osmosis (passive)'.

qe: Which glycolytic enzyme complex in yeast converts pyruvate into ethanol and carbon dioxide during fermentation?
qh: किण्वन (Fermentation) के दौरान ग्लूकोज को एथिल अल्कोहल और CO2 में बदलने वाला एंजाइम कॉम्प्लेक्स कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Yeast (khamir) me fermentation ke dauran pyruvic acid do hisson me toot jata hai - Ethanol (sharab) aur Carbon dioxide - aur ye kaam karne wale enzyme complex ko Zymase kehte hain (isme 12 se zyada enzymes hote hain). Isi reaction se beer/wine aur bread ka phulaav (CO2) hota hai. Baaki teen enzymes alag kaam karte hain: Lactase lactose (doodh sugar) todta hai, Amylase starch ko sugar me badalta hai, aur Invertase sucrose ko glucose + fructose me todta hai. Exam point: 'Pyruvate = Ethanol + CO2 = Zymase (fermentation)'.
